title: Project Manager – Security Installation
summary: Lead a major on-site security installation project in Belgium, coordinating Project Managers and Package Managers.
description: Lead a major on-site security installation project in Belgium, coordinating Project Managers and Package Managers.

sections.heading: Main Duties and Responsibilities
items: Plan and manage security installation from mobilisation to handover.
Lead project and package teams across technical workstreams.
Enforce technical specifications, security protocols and health and safety standards.
Act as main on-site client contact, reporting schedules, risks and milestones.

sections.heading: Qualifications and Experience
items: Experience delivering complex security, electrical or technical infrastructure installations.
Strong multidisciplinary team and subcontractor leadership.
Unrestricted right to work in EU without sponsorship.

sections.heading: Package & Benefits
items: Travel and accommodation covered, plus a tax-free monthly subsistence allowance as stated in the supplied role document.
